newsitem.title: USA: "Seinfeld" cast sign mult-million dollar contracts.
newsitem.headline: "Seinfeld" cast sign mult-million dollar contracts.

text.p: The cast of the hit NBC television series "Seinfeld" signed a multi-million dollar contract renewing the show by one season, with an option for a second season, Variety reported on Sunday.

Citing sources, Variety said cast members including Jason Alexander, Julia Louis-Dreyfus and Michael Richards agreed to a contract that raised their per-episode salaries from $150,000 to about $600,000.
Variety said the cast will each earn at least $13.2 million if they do 22 shows next season, which will be the series' ninth.
Jerry Seinfeld, the star of the show as well as its co-creator and producer of the comedy series, will get about $1 million per episode, the sources said.
Seinfeld also receives about $40 million from residuals.
The show is produced by Time Warner Inc's Castle Rock Entertainment. NBC is a subisidary of General Electric, Officials from both companies were unavailable for comment.
